_about: The only place a color is written (D17). crates/content/tests/palette.rs fails on any value in the red band, and on a color written anywhere in web/. Each value says what it paints.

art._about: The region art behind the arcade chart (analysis/art/regions.py), after Sam_Comm_final.png: flat fills, plum ink lines, a mustard sky, peach and sage. Warm tones sit just past the red band.

cursed._about: The cursed blade (Sam, 2026-10-07): a blade of two strands twisting about each other, one black and one red, and the liquid that gathers in its box as the player wins. Sam asked for a red strand; the red band is closed to every palette color (crates/content/tests/palette.rs, CLAUDE.md), so strand_b is a deep violet until he rules on it.
